name: Qwen
description: Qwen is Alibaba Cloud’s model team. Alibaba’s principal executive offices are in Hangzhou, China. Its mission is to create large language and multimodal models that support multilingual, flexible tasks and broaden access to foundational AI capabilities.

sources.notes: Qwen's official about page identifies the Qwen Team and its Alibaba Cloud / ALiYun affiliation.
Alibaba's official FAQ lists its principal executive offices in Hangzhou, China; this is recorded as the parent-company location.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified for the parent company; Qwen is not treated as a separate legal headquarters.
